name: ImageRotateDrawingAxis
description: Rotates all subsequent drawing on a image at a specified point by a specified angle.
syntax: ImageRotateDrawingAxis( any image, [number angle], [number x], [number y] )

params.name: image
params.description: The image on which this operation is performed.

params.name: x
params.description: The x coordinate for the point of rotation. The default value is 0.

params.name: y
params.description: The y coordinate for the point of rotation. The default value is 0.
